claims: Assess and manage severe anemia (Hgb 7.8 g/dL, Hct 24.2%) with consideration for transfusion and evaluation for bleeding source.
Evaluate acute kidney injury with creatinine 5.1 mg/dL and BUN 57 mg/dL; assess volume status and nephrotoxic exposures.

Maintain fall precautions given history of falls and bed rest status.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis assessment and mobilization as tolerated.
Recheck complete blood count and renal function within 24 hours to trend anemia and AKI.
